draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Glad to hear week one is going well, and thanks for your patience on the bulk import question -- your ticket is still open on our side.

One thing that may help: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and you can also invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a couple of colleagues in alongside your first project usually makes the layout click faster.

Want me to walk through it with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
